annotations.text:
CALENDAR

A fourth tab. Every payment lands on the day it is due, or was paid. Phone: dots in the grid (category colour = due, green = paid, red = overdue), tap a day to list it, plus the next 7 days. Desktop: the day cells are big enough to carry name + amount chips, and the side column shows the selected day, month totals, and the next 7 days.

Rows reuse the This month bill row, so ticking works here too. The trailing days of October show next month's bills faded.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Not a new data source: a template flagged as a subscription. They still land as bills in This month and get ticked there.

Plan gets a Subscriptions section above Every month, sorted by next renewal, with a monthly figure (yearly ones count a twelfth), a yearly figure, and the next renewal. Trials show when they convert. Cancel reuses Stop after a month.

Sheet: two new fields, a subscription switch and an optional trial end date. Renews-on-day is the existing due day.
Desktop This month gains this card in the right column, under Next up. Three nearest renewals only.
